CHANGED this correction batch: this fixture is now the FULL, untrimmed
original workbook (54 KB, byte-identical to the sha256 above), not a
7-row trim. Prior batches shipped a curated 7-row trim of the same
source; this batch replaces it with the whole file because the
correction batch's own regression test requirement is "ingest the FULL
306-row history and assert every row's invariant holds — not a sampled
row" (see decode_test.go's
TestDecode_FullHistoryEveryRowSatisfiesArithmeticInvariant). A trimmed
fixture cannot back that test: the whole point is that a spot check
already produced two wrong conclusions about this workbook (Engram
#4699, then a further incorrect "moving total column" claim in Engram
#4709 — both refuted in decode.go's package doc comment) before an
exhaustive, all-306-rows sweep against a file this size (54 KB) settled
it. Checking in the real, unmodified file removes any risk that a
hand-curated trim quietly drops the one row (Julio 2013, row 154) that
carries the only rounding discrepancy over the tolerance the invariant
must absorb.

Structure (verified against this exact file):
- Sheet Hoja1 (the only sheet). Row 1 title, row 2 régimen group header
  (N2 = "TOTAL SISTEMA" — the workbook's own label for the total
  column), row 3 column headers, data rows 4-309 (306 monthly
  observations, Enero 2001 - Junio 2026), footnote rows from row 310
  (terminator: column A stops matching a period label and starts
  matching ^\(\d+\)).
- Zero formula cells anywhere in the columns this package reads (period,
  total, every component) — see
  TestDecode_SelectorIndependenceRealFixtureHasNoFormulaCells.
- Column N carries the system total in ALL 306 rows (not merely a
  post-2017 subset). Columns B-M are the component columns; blank cells
  are treated as zero and are populated in different, non-overlapping
  date ranges as régimenes are created/retired (footnotes "(9)
  Extinguido 1-enero-2008", "(2) Vigente desde 1-enero-2012") — this is a
  component-set change, not a total-column change.
- Row 3 mislabels column K "Discontínuos (7)" — a genuine, separate
  régimen sub-category, not the total, despite the header/data-column
  misalignment (merged cells in rows 2-3) that makes header text
  untrustworthy for column mapping in general.
- Column O ("Cuidadores (10)") is a memo item, added 2008, explicitly
  excluded from both the total and the component set.
- The verified double-space period-label trap ("Febrero  2001" through
  "Febrero  2006") and the trailing-newline header trap ("REGIMEN
  GENERAL\n", "Régimen General (1) \n") are both present in this file as
  published.
